name: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3（TP=2 · DFlash2 · 1M）
description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）双节点 TP=2 服务——EXL3/TR3 路线：Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw 权重镜像（brandonmusic 快照，~164GiB/120 分片）+ fp8 KV（packed fp8_ds_mla）+ DFlash2 k=7 投机，MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS 2048（上游 2026-08-29 P1 keep，冷 prefill +3–16%、decode 无税），1M 上下文（padded slot-share）；Vision 默认开启（image×4 / video×1）。实测 decode：单流 62.9 tok/s（×2 聚合 103.3 / ×4 聚合 146.5）。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm53-exl3:
    image: ${GLM53EXL3_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm53-flash-exl3:v1.0.0}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8888}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present  # 节点不支持 pull，镜像由集群镜像仓库分发到各节点；本地已有即用
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把主模型 + DFlash2 草稿都放在 /root/.cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它，按 HF repo id 离线解析）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/root/.cache/huggingface
      # CUDA graph / JIT 编译缓存挂持久卷，容器重建不丢
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}:/root/.cache/vllm
      # Triton / TileLang JIT 缓存：overlay 内核编译慢，随持久卷保存（源 launcher 也挂这两个）
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}/triton:/root/.triton/cache
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}/tilelang:/root/.tilelang/cache
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /root/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /root/.cache/vllm
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "${VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}"  # 上源 1800（冷启动 JIT 超时长）
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.triton/cache"
      TILELANG_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.tilelang/cache"
      VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS: "1"  # py-cpuinfo/aarch64 usage 线程 JSONDecodeError；源 launcher 关统计
      DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"
      LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY: "${LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY:-0}"
      LIMIT_MM: "${LIMIT_MM:-}"
      # 上游 overlay 行为开关（哨兵执行，缺文件自动跳过）
      # 镜像侧记录：ACR 按上游现行 Dockerfile 烘焙（@493cb88，2026-08-31）；suppress_stops/scheduler_decode_floor/hybrid_prefix_hit/xgrammar/kpool 五个补丁已全部入镜像并通过构建自检
      EXL3_FUSED_MOE: "${EXL3_FUSED_MOE:-1}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS:-1}"  # 0 = 去掉 CUDA-graph 显存预留，还 KV（graphs 仍开；上游 CG_ESTIMATE）
      GLM53_MIXED_PREFILL_CHUNK: "${GLM53_MIXED_PREFILL_CHUNK:-skip}"
      GLM53_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING: "${GLM53_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING:-1}"
      # SM121 架构 + fp8_ds_mla KV 所需（源 launcher 全部保留）
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # 网络：RoCE（CX7 直连），HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_NET_PLUGIN: none
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "0"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "1"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        set -e;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_glm_video_placeholders.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_glm_video_placeholders.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_suppress_stops_in_reasoning.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_suppress_stops_in_reasoning.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_scheduler_decode_floor.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_scheduler_decode_floor.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_glm5_drafter_group.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_glm5_drafter_group.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_hybrid_prefix_hit.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_hybrid_prefix_hit.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_xgrammar_termination.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_xgrammar_termination.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_kpool_tail_slotmap.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_kpool_tail_slotmap.py; fi;
        if [ "$${LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY:-0}" = "1" ]; then
          MM_ARGS="--language-model-only";
        else
          if [ -z "$${LIMIT_MM:-}" ]; then LIMIT_MM='{"image":4,"video":1}'; fi;
          MM_ARGS="--limit-mm-per-prompt $${LIMIT_MM} --skip-mm-profiling";
        fi;
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM53EXL3_MODEL_PATH:-Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-4bpw}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3}
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8888}
        --tensor-parallel-size 2
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.87}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1000000}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-4}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-2048}
        --quantization exl3
        --kv-cache-dtype ${KV_CACHE_DTYPE:-fp8}
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"${GLM53EXL3_DRAFT_PATH:-incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2}","num_speculative_tokens":${GLM53EXL3_DFLASH_TOKENS:-7},"kv_cache_dtype":"auto","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"standard","draft_tensor_parallel_size":${GLM53EXL3_DFLASH_DRAFT_TP:-2}}'
        --cudagraph-capture-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 24 32
        --chat-template ${CHAT_TEMPLATE:-/opt/glm53/chat_template.jinja}
        $${MM_ARGS}
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-2}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29521}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: ACR 烘焙 EXL3 overlay 镜像（按上游 MiaAI-Lab 现行 Dockerfile @493cb88 / 2026-08-31：FROM vllm-openai glm53-flash-arm64-cu130）：NoPE-MLA SM121 sparse 补丁 + exllamav3_ext（sm_121a）+ DFlash2/EAGLE3/video 补丁 + MM chat 模板 + suppress_stops/scheduler_decode_floor/hybrid_prefix_hit/xgrammar/kpool 五个运行时补丁全部烘焙
variables.help_en: ACR-baked EXL3 overlay image (from upstream MiaAI-Lab current Dockerfile @493cb88 / 2026-08-31: FROM vllm-openai glm53-flash-arm64-cu130): NoPE-MLA SM121 sparse patches + exllamav3_ext (sm_121a) + DFlash2/EAGLE3/video patches + MM chat template + all five runtime patches (suppress_stops / scheduler_decode_floor / hybrid_prefix_hit / xgrammar / kpool) baked in

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: EXL3/TR3 uniform-K4 4bpw 量化主模型（~164GiB、brandonmusic 快照 5ab363a8… 的 Mia-AiLab 公共镜像，上游主路；镜像 404/120 分片不齐时回退 brandonmusic/GLM-5.3-Flash-tr3-4bpw）；请勿换 NVFP4 权重/marlin
variables.help_en: EXL3/TR3 uniform-K4 4bpw quant main model (~164 GiB; public Mia-AiLab mirror of the brandonmusic snapshot 5ab363a8…, upstream primary; falls back to brandonmusic/GLM-5.3-Flash-tr3-4bpw if the mirror is incomplete) — do not swap in NVFP4 weights / marlin

variables.label: DFlash2 Drafter 模型
variables.help: DFlash2 块扩散草稿模型（~2.3GiB BF16，CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 研究/评测）；与主模型一样分发给节点 HF 缓存，按 repo id 离线解析
variables.help_en: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model (~2.3 GiB BF16, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 research/eval); distributed to the node HF cache like the main model and resolved offline by repo id

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 上源 launcher 生产档：1,000,000（padded slot-share 后 1M 分配得出，旧 900k 是同池 1.95× 补丁阶段）；util 0.87 下 KV 池 1,754,237 token（约 18.67 GiB、690 GPU blocks，1.75× 满 1M 请求）；不要为“释放 KV”降到 256k
variables.help_en: Upstream launcher production value: 1,000,000 (padded slot-share is why 1M allocates; the old 900k cap was 1.95× on this same pool); KV pool 1,754,237 tokens (~18.67 GiB, 690 GPU blocks, 1.75× a full 1M request) at util 0.87. Do not drop to 256k to “free” KV

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 上游生产 4（decode 批）；MTP/投机每序列额外加 k+1 token
variables.help_en: Upstream production 4 (decode batch); speculation adds k+1 tokens per sequence

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 上游 2026-08-29 P1 阶梯 keep 值 2048：8k TTFT 10.36s/772 → 8.93s/895、100k 947→975、decode 无退化（structured 还快到 65.9）。3584/4096 实测被 LinearEXL3 胖 expert 税吃掉、已 revert；永远别上 8192（GB10 indexer top-k smem 撑爆）；也不要为前缀缓存命中而调它
variables.help_en: Upstream 2026-08-29 P1 ladder keep: 2048 — 8k TTFT 10.36s/772 → 8.93s/895, 100k 947→975, no decode regression (structured even hit 65.9). 3584/4096 lost to the LinearEXL3 fat-expert tax and were reverted; never 8192 (GB10 indexer top-k smem); do not tune it for APC either

variables.label: 融合 EXL3 MoE
variables.help: 1 = 每层单次融合 exllamav3_ext.exl3_moe launch；0 = 独立 expert 的 LinearEXL3 循环（慢）。上游默认 1
variables.help_en: 1 = one fused exllamav3_ext.exl3_moe launch per layer; 0 = unique-expert LinearEXL3 loop (slower). Upstream default 1

variables.label: 混合 prefill 策略
variables.help: decode 进行中不让同一步混入 peer prefill（上游 issue #6：混合会把 decode 压到 ~5 tok/s）。skip = 本步跳过 prefill；N>0 = 上限 N token；0/off = 关。单路 prefill 上限跟随 MNBT（2048）；更大块让 decode 交错更粗，skip 反而更重要
variables.help_en: Do not mix a peer prefill into a decode step (upstream issue #6: mixing stalls decode at ~5 tok/s). skip = defer this step; N>0 = cap at N tokens; 0/off = off. Solo prefill follows MNBT (2048 now); bigger chunks make decode interleave coarser, so skip matters more

variables.label: thinking 内抑制 stop
variables.help: 1（默认）= 客户端 stop 字符串在 </thinking> 前保持休眠（thinking 默认开启时防止提前截断）；0 = 关
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = keep client stop strings dormant until </thinking> (thinking-on default); 0 = off

variables.label: CUDA graph 显存预留估算
variables.help: 1 = vLLM 0.21 默认：从 KV 池扣掉 CUDA-graph 显存估计（上游同款，本机估计约 1.74 GiB、上游 2.43 GiB）；0 = 只去掉这项预留（CUDA graphs 仍开启），把 ~2.6 GiB 还回 KV——KV 池差口气时优先试试它
variables.help_en: 1 = vLLM 0.21 default: subtracts a CUDA-graph memory estimate from the KV pool (upstream CG_ESTIMATE; ~1.74 GiB here, 2.43 GiB on upstream); 0 = drop only that deduction with CUDA graphs still ON, returning ~2.6 GiB to KV — try this first if the KV pool comes up short

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help:
上源实机验证 0.87（他们机器池 ~18.67 GiB）；KV 余量随 boot 浮动。若本机 boot 的 Available KV cache memory < 14.61 GiB（1M 硬需求），
先确认节点上 :exl3 与上游同版本（镜像经集群分发），再调高此值（≥0.90）；过高会缩小 MM/长 prefill 峰值余量
variables.help_en: Upstream validated on hardware at 0.87 (pool ~18.67 GiB on their kit); KV headroom drifts per boot. If your boot reports Available KV cache memory < 14.61 GiB (the 1M floor), first make sure the :exl3 on the nodes is the same build as upstream (images are distributed via the cluster mirror), then raise this value (>=0.90). Too high shrinks the headroom over the MM / long-prefill activation peak

variables.label: KV 缓存类型
variables.help: 上游要求 fp8（packed fp8_ds_mla，唯一的 sparse-MLA 后端）；bf16 无 sparse 核、nvfp4 只支持 dense MHA——都别用
variables.help_en: Upstream requires fp8 (packed fp8_ds_mla, the only sparse-MLA backend); bf16 has no sparse kernel and nvfp4 is dense-MHA-only — do not use either

variables.label: DFlash2 投机 token 数
variables.help: 必须是 7（trained block 8）：上游 k=7 档位
variables.help_en: Must be 7 (trained block 8): the upstream k=7 tier

variables.label: Drafter TP（1 = rank0 独占）
variables.help: 2（默认，上游 2026-08-30 keep；镜像已按上游现行 overlay 重建，structured 65.1 tok/s）——drafter 跨 TP 分片，每步投机不过 CX7；1 = 2.3GiB 草稿只留 rank 0；留空 = 继承目标 TP
variables.help_en: 2 (default, upstream 2026-08-30 keep; image rebuilt from upstream current overlay, structured 65.1 tok/s) — shard the drafter across TP so speculation never crosses CX7; 1 = keep the 2.3 GiB draft on rank 0; empty = inherit target TP

variables.label: 仅文本（不加载视觉塔）
variables.help: 0（默认）= 加载视觉塔（image×4 / video×1）；1 = --language-model-only，纯文本更快
variables.help_en: 0 (default) = load the vision tower (image×4 / video×1); 1 = --language-model-only (text-only, faster)

variables.label: 跳过 MM dummy profile
variables.help: 保持 1：最大规格的 image+video dummy profile 会 OOM 本 UMA
variables.help_en: Keep 1: a max-size image+video dummy profile OOMs this UMA

variables.label: 每请求多模态上限
variables.help: --limit-mm-per-prompt 的 JSON（默认 {"image":4,"video":1}；清空则回退该默认）
variables.help_en: JSON for --limit-mm-per-prompt (default {"image":4,"video":1}; clearing it falls back to the default)

variables.label: Chat 模板路径
variables.help: 镜像内 MM 模板（<|image|>/<|video|>，源仓库 files/chat_template.jinja 烘焙）；checkpoint 自带的是 language-only 版
variables.help_en: In-image MM template (<|image|>/<|video|>, baked from files/chat_template.jinja); the checkpoint's built-in one is language-only

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail（源单 rail：rocep1s0f1 / rocep1s0f0）
variables.help_en: The hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node (upstream single-rail: rocep1s0f1 / rocep1s0f0)

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: auto 返回首选 RoCE 口（源：enp1s0f1np1 ↔ enp1s0f0np0）；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: auto returns the preferred RoCE interface (upstream: enp1s0f1np1 ↔ enp1s0f0np0); override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 硬编码 3）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (upstream hard-codes 3)

description_en: 2-node TP=2 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) on the EXL3/TR3 lane: Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw weight mirror (brandonmusic snapshot, ~164 GiB / 120 shards) + fp8 KV (packed fp8_ds_mla) + DFlash2 k=7 speculation, max-num-batched-tokens 2048 (upstream 2026-08-29 P1 keep, +3-16% cold prefill at no decode cost), 1M context (padded slot-share); Vision on by default (image×4 / video×1). Measured decode: 62.9 tok/s single-stream (2-way aggregate 103.3 / 4-way aggregate 146.5).
